title: axi.analysis response
description: Analyze AXI latency, pending transactions, and outstanding activity.
x-output_notes: axi.analysis 成功响应的 summary 字段为 summary.analysis, summary.analysis_complete, summary.avg, summary.buffered_w_beat_count, summary.buffered_w_burst_count, summary.channel_handshakes, summary.completed_read_count, summary.completed_write_count, summary.direction, summary.full_scan_count, summary.incomplete_read_count, summary.incomplete_write_count, summary.max, summary.min, summary.name, summary.orphan_b_count, summary.orphan_r_beat_count, summary.orphan_w_beat_count, summary.p50, summary.p95, summary.p99, summary.response_dependency_violation_count, summary.response_truncated, summary.returned_count, summary.sample_count, summary.samples, summary.scan_complete, summary.scanned_range, summary.status, summary.total_count, summary.truncation_scopes, summary.value_width_complete, summary.width_diagnostics；data 字段为 data.latency, data.osd, data.pending_transactions, data.slowest。未知字段会被拒绝。完整性和裁剪事实使用 summary.scan_complete, summary.analysis_complete, summary.response_truncated, summary.total_count, summary.returned_count, summary.truncation_scopes。

jsonObject.description: 显式动态键 JSON 对象；每个 value 仍受 jsonValue 递归合同约束。

signal.description: One-bit final waveform signal path used as reset.

polarity.description: Level that asserts reset. X, Z, and unavailable samples are conservatively treated as asserted.

reset.description: Reset definition. Both signal and polarity are required when reset is supplied.
